sanitizer_scope.scope: ASAN+UBSAN complete original CLI; one crashing tagless fixture and positive existing optional tag fixture, not full sanitizer suite

findings: Top-bit keys alias in generic hash module; actual production signatures use bounded27bit bin offsets, so this is outside intended key domain, not proof of biological false matches.

addMateTags with no optional fields crashes in native CLI; adding existing NM tag is positive control. No final newline truncates final quality byte; integer suffix junk accepted; negative maxReadLength accepted on header-only input.
Sequence bytes/quality/RG tags deliberately absent from signature; first record survives regardless of quality. These are declared domain limitations, not file-content identity.
Global slab allocator and freeHashTableNodes do not reset global lists; not a reusable thread-safe library lifecycle. Static finding, repeat teardown not tested.
Signature index space grows quadratically with genome bins; oversized parameter/contig integer arithmetic and memory admission not comprehensively qualified. Static only.
decision: Reject biological signature equivalence as file/image identity. Reference streaming and collision-node slab layout only with explicit key-domain/lifecycle contracts; no production adoption or speed claim.
limits: Synthetic owned SAM only, no actual sequencing dataset or comparative precision/performance/resource campaign.
No production code copied; no claim of portable arbitrary64bit key safety or thread-safe global slab reuse.
ASAN+UBSAN verifies tagless crash and tagged positive control only; not complete sanitizer suite. Native current-root quality/formats/platform/performance scope remains open.
